$comment: Kun Fayakun Intelligence's engines (src/ai/engine): why a device gets the model it does, what each model size cannot do well, and why a load failed. Loaded with the engine host's chunk (createEngineHost). Plain words; the guide works on every device, so no message implies the visitor needs a model.
ai.engine.browser.name: This browser's built-in model
ai.engine.browser.downloadable: Starting it makes the browser download its own model first, which can take several gigabytes.
ai.engine.reason.insecure: This page is not open over a secure connection, so the browser keeps WebGPU switched off.
ai.engine.reason.ios: On iPhone and iPad, Safari closes tabs that use much memory, so the guide is offered instead of a model.
ai.engine.reason.firefox: The models have not been checked in Firefox yet, so the guide is offered instead.
ai.engine.reason.no-webgpu: This browser has no WebGPU, which the models need. The guide works without it.
ai.engine.reason.fallback-adapter: Only a software graphics adapter is available here, which would make a model far too slow.
ai.engine.reason.limits: This graphics adapter's limits are below what the models need.
ai.engine.reason.adapter-hidden: The browser does not say which graphics card this is (Brave's Shields hide it), so the suggestion errs on the small side. You can choose a larger model.
ai.engine.reason.no-f16: This graphics adapter has no 16-bit shaders, so the 32-bit builds are used. They need more memory.
ai.engine.reason.android-unknown: This phone does not say how much memory it has, so no model is suggested.
ai.engine.reason.android-small: This phone has 4 GB of memory or less: not enough for a model beside the scene.
ai.engine.reason.memory-unknown: This browser does not say how much memory the device has, so a middle size is assumed. You can choose a larger model, though it may not fit.
ai.engine.reason.memory-small: This device reports less than 4 GB of memory: not enough for a model beside the scene.
ai.engine.reason.discrete: A separate graphics card is present, so a larger model can fit.
ai.engine.reason.large-buffer: The graphics adapter can hold very large buffers, so a larger model can fit.
ai.engine.reason.too-small: Even the smallest model needs more graphics memory than can be spared here.
ai.engine.reason.crashed: Last time the page stopped while a model was starting, so a size smaller is suggested.
ai.engine.limit.pocket.tools: Picks a tool and its settings from a short list, and does little more.
ai.engine.limit.pocket.explain: Its explanations are weak: short, sometimes muddled, best read beside the passages shown with them.
ai.engine.limit.pocket.plans: Cannot follow a task with several steps.
ai.engine.limit.compact.tools: Reliable with one tool at a time; tasks with several steps often go wrong.
ai.engine.limit.compact.explain: Its explanations are short and keep close to the passages shown.
ai.engine.limit.standard.plans: Can lose track of long tasks with many steps.
ai.engine.limit.large.speed: Slow to start and to answer on most laptops, with the largest download and the most graphics memory.
ai.engine.limit.facts: Not a source of facts: numbers, scripture and facts come from the app's verified data, never from the model.
ai.engine.limit.context: Remembers only the last few turns of a conversation.
ai.engine.error.no-webgpu: This browser has no WebGPU, so no model can run here. The guide still answers.
ai.engine.error.too-small: This device cannot spare enough graphics memory for that model. Try a smaller one, or use the guide.
ai.engine.error.quota: The browser would not store the model: there is not enough room. Free some space or remove a stored model, then try again.
ai.engine.error.network: The model could not be downloaded. Check the connection and try again; what was already fetched is kept.
ai.engine.error.aborted: Stopped. What was already downloaded is kept, so it can carry on later.
ai.engine.error.device-lost: The graphics device stopped while the model was working. The page is fine; a smaller model may work.
ai.engine.error.out-of-memory: The graphics card ran out of memory for this model. A smaller model may work.
ai.engine.error.integrity: A downloaded file did not match its pinned checksum, so it was not used.
ai.engine.error.unsupported: This browser cannot run that model here.
ai.engine.error.unknown: The model could not be started. The guide still answers.
